Name: Shelomith
Summary: Shelomith was the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan, and the mother of the man who blasphemed the Name and was stoned.
KeyStory: Shelomith's son fought with an Israelite in the camp, blasphemed the Name, and was put in custody until Moses inquired of the LORD — and her name is preserved in the law that followed.
LifeLesson: A mother's name can be remembered even in her family's hardest chapter — God does not look away.
